$comment: LCARdS 2026.10.0-dev.1: generated from src/cards/schemas/ by scripts/generate-llm-schema.js; do not hand-edit.
title: MSD Card
description: Master Systems Display card with overlays and routing

id.description: Custom card ID for rule targeting (optional - auto-generated if omitted)

tags.description: Tags for bulk rule targeting and grouping. Allows applying rules to multiple cards at once using tag selectors.

oneOf.description: Card height in pixels (bare integer, e.g. 56 = 56px)

height.description: Card height override. Bare integer = px (e.g. 200 = 200px). CSS units accepted: 200px, 50vh, 10em.

oneOf.description: Card width in pixels (bare integer, e.g. 300 = 300px)

width.description: Card width override. Bare integer = px (e.g. 400 = 400px). CSS units accepted: 400px, 50vw, 10em.

oneOf.description: Minimum card height in pixels (bare integer, e.g. 40 = 40px)
Minimum card height with CSS unit (e.g. 40px, 10vh)

min_height.description: Minimum card height floor. Overrides the --lcards-button-min-height CSS token. Bare integer = px.

oneOf.description: Minimum card width in pixels (bare integer, e.g. 80 = 80px)
Minimum card width with CSS unit (e.g. 80px, 10vw)

min_width.description: Minimum card width floor. Bare integer = px.

oneOf.description: Maximum card height in pixels (bare integer, e.g. 400 = 400px)
Maximum card height with CSS unit (e.g. 400px, 80vh, 20em)

max_height.description: Maximum card height ceiling. Bare integer = px (e.g. 400 = 400px). CSS units accepted: 400px, 80vh, 10em.

oneOf.description: Maximum card width in pixels (bare integer, e.g. 600 = 600px)
Maximum card width with CSS unit (e.g. 600px, 80vw, 20em)

max_width.description: Maximum card width ceiling. Bare integer = px (e.g. 600 = 600px). CSS units accepted: 600px, 80vw, 10em.

overflow.description: CSS overflow shorthand on the card host element (sets both axes unless overridden per-axis).

overflow_x.description: CSS overflow-x on the card host element. Overrides the overflow shorthand for the horizontal axis.

overflow_y.description: CSS overflow-y on the card host element. Overrides the overflow shorthand for the vertical axis.

z_index.description: CSS z-index stacking order on the card host element.

base_svg.title: Base SVG Configuration
base_svg.description: Background SVG the overlays draw on. Optional when view_box is set (a blank canvas).

source.description: SVG source: builtin:key, /local/path.svg, a media-source://… content ID (picked via the HA media library), or "none"

filters.description: Stackable CSS/SVG filters applied in sequence

render_visual.description: Whether the base SVG is painted as the visible background. Set false to use background_animation (e.g. a static image or animated layers) as the visual background instead, while the SVG is still parsed for anchors as normal.

harvest_landmarks.description: Compute geometric landmark anchors (hull_center, extremity_bow/stern/top/bottom, lateral_a/b) from the base SVG silhouette.

harvest_svg_elements.description: Harvest anchors from named <circle>/<ellipse>/<text>/<rect>/<g> elements embedded in the base SVG.

animations.description: Animations targeting elements inside the base SVG (by id/class, same target syntax as overlay animations)

anchors.description: Named anchor points for overlay positioning

overlays.description: Array of overlay configurations (validated by overlay schemas)

tags.description: Tags for rule targeting: a rule selector `tag:<name>` matches every overlay carrying that tag.

type.errorMessage: Only "line", "control", and "shape" overlay types supported. Use LCARdS cards for buttons/charts.

kind.description: Shape overlays only: geometry primitive. polyline uses `points` (+ optional `closed`); rect/circle use `position` + `size` like control overlays.

points.description: Shape overlays (kind: polyline) only: ordered vertex list. Each entry is either [x, y] in viewBox units or a static anchor-name string. Minimum 2 points.

closed.description: Shape overlays (kind: polyline) only: close the path back to its first point and allow `style.fill`.

entity.description: Line overlays: entity to bind style.color to (state-color object); see style.color. Not used by control overlays, which already have their own entity via the embedded card.

state_attribute.description: Line overlays: attribute whose string value is matched against style.color state keys instead of the raw entity state (e.g. "fade", "true"); mirrors the button card's state_attribute, scoped per-line

ranges_attribute.description: Line overlays: attribute value compared against above:/below:/between: keys in style.color; mirrors the button card's ranges_attribute, scoped per-line

style.description: Line/shape overlay styling (color, width, opacity, dash pattern, markers, gradient/pattern fill, etc.)

color.description: Stroke color: a literal/token/CSS value, or a state-color object resolved against `entity` (same state-color pipeline as buttons/sliders; requires `entity` to be set)

width.description: Stroke width in viewBox units (alias: stroke_width)

line_cap.description: Stroke line cap style, applied to every dash segment (use with dash_array "0,N" and line_cap: round for true circular dots). Has no visible effect on a solid (non-dashed) closed shape.

line_join.description: Stroke line join style at path vertices. Meaningful for polyline and rect; no effect on circle/ellipse.

miter_limit.description: Miter limit, used when line_join is "miter"

fill.description: Fill color: a literal/token/CSS value, or a state-color object resolved against `entity` (same state-color pipeline as `color`). Only visible on closed shapes (rect, circle, closed polyline).

pattern.description: Pattern fill configuration (dots, lines, diagonal, grid, or custom SVG content)

marker_start.description: Marker (arrowhead/dot/etc.) at the path start. Polyline shapes only; meaningless for rect/circle.

marker_mid.description: Marker at each interior path vertex. Polyline shapes only; meaningless for rect/circle.

marker_end.description: Marker at the path end. Polyline shapes only; meaningless for rect/circle.

animatable.description: Whether this overlay is eligible as an anime.js animation target

position.description: Control overlay, or shape overlay (kind: rect/circle): named anchor (e.g. "hub") or absolute coordinates [x, y]. The anchor is the center of the card/shape by default.

size.description: Control overlay, or shape overlay (kind: rect/circle) size [width, height] in SVG coordinates. For kind: circle, an ellipse is drawn with rx=width/2, ry=height/2 (use equal width/height for a perfect circle).

attachment.description: Which point of the control card aligns with the anchor position. Default: center

position_side.description: Control overlays only: when position references another control's id, which point of that target control to align to (instead of its center). Ignored for named-anchor or coordinate positions.

card.description: HA card config embedded in this control overlay

oneOf.description: Extra entity IDs (or MSD data-source refs) this overlay depends on, beyond what static analysis of `card` can detect. HA entity IDs are folded into a control overlay's HASS change-detection set; non-entity refs are subscribed as MSD data-source updates (existing behavior, any overlay type).

Control overlays only: this control receives every HASS update unconditionally, bypassing the per-control entity-diff optimization. Use when the embedded card's entity dependencies genuinely can't be enumerated (e.g. wildcard/device-class auto-discovery alert cards). Prefer the array form when possible.

locked.description: Control/shape overlays only: when true, MSD Studio's editor canvas disables drag/resize/vertex-editing for this overlay (Edit/Duplicate/Delete in the list panel remain available). Editor-only; has no effect on runtime rendering or line overlays.

anchor.description: Line overlays: start-point anchor name or [x,y]. Control overlays: deprecated alias for position; use position instead.

anchor_side.description: Line overlays: which side of the anchor overlay the line departs from (top, bottom, left, right, center)

anchor_gap.description: Line overlays: gap in SVG units between line endpoint and anchor edge

attach_to.description: Line overlays: destination anchor name, overlay ID, or [x, y]

attach_side.description: Line overlays: which side of the attach_to overlay the line arrives at (top, bottom, left, right, center)

attach_gap.description: Line overlays: gap in SVG units between line endpoint and attach_to edge

route.description: Routing algorithm. auto (recommended): always full pathfinding (obstacle avoidance, trunk bundling, crossing avoidance) regardless of whether obstacles/channels are present. direct: straight line, no pathfinding. manual: explicit waypoints. Escape hatches for the cheap/non-participating alternative: manhattan (fixed 2-elbow shape, no pathfinding, no bundling, no crossing avoidance) or grid (pathfinding + bundling/crossing avoidance, without the extra local-search refinement pass smart adds). smart is what auto resolves to.

waypoints.description: Array of waypoints for manual routing. Each waypoint is a coordinate pair [x, y], optionally [x, y, radius] to override this corner's rounding radius (round) or chamfer size (bevel); omit the 3rd slot to inherit corner_radius. A waypoint can also be an anchor name string. Line will pass through waypoints in order.

route_hint.description: Initial segment direction hint: empty/auto (geometry-based), xy = horizontal first, yx = vertical first

route_hint_last.description: Final segment direction hint: empty/auto (same as route_hint), xy = vertical last, yx = horizontal last

route_channels.description: Array of channel IDs this line should route through

clearance.description: Minimum clearance around obstacles in viewBox units (overrides global default)

corner_style.description: Line overlays, or shape overlays (kind: polyline): how corners are rendered. For shape kind: rect, maps to rx/ry (round only); no effect on circle/ellipse.

corner_radius.description: Line overlays, or shape overlays (kind: polyline): corner cut size in viewBox units: arc radius for round corners, or diagonal chamfer size for bevel corners. For shape kind: rect, sets rx/ry directly.

corner_radius_mode.description: Line overlays only (routing behavior, not shape overlay rendering): whether corner_radius is a target or a hard requirement for round/bevel corners. auto (default): corner size may shrink so the router stays free to avoid forcing a detour or an unnecessary line crossing near tight geometry. forced: always reserves room for the full configured radius, matching pre-2026.07 behavior; can force routing detours or crossings.

corner_room_weight.description: Line overlays only, round/bevel corner_style: how strongly the smart-routing refinement pass tries to recover this line's full corner_radius when a tight detour would otherwise shrink it. On by default (card-wide default in routing.corner_room_weight); a route that leaves more room for the configured corner is preferred over the plain-cheapest route, when the difference is small. Set to 0 on a line to opt it out.

corner_angle.description: Bevel corners only (line overlays, or shape overlays of kind: polyline): angle of the diagonal cut in degrees (0=cut flush with incoming edge, 90=flush with outgoing edge, 45=symmetric diagonal), matching the elbow card's diagonal-cap angle

stub_length.description: Line overlays only: overrides the mandatory cardinal stub length (viewBox units) departing/arriving anchor_side or attach_side, instead of the router's own auto-computed floor (which scales with grid_resolution and can force a longer straight lead-out than a specific line's own geometry needs). Leave unset for the default. Going below one grid cell risks re-triggering an internal same-cell short-circuit; use window.lcards.debug.msd.routing.inspect(id).meta.debug to see the router's own resolved value first.

smoothing_mode.description: Line overlays, or shape overlays (kind: polyline) only: path smoothing algorithm

smoothing_iterations.description: Line overlays, or shape overlays (kind: polyline) only: number of smoothing iterations to apply

animations.description: Animations that bulk-target overlays in the shared overlay group by CSS selector (data-overlay-id, class, etc.), e.g. animate every overlay whose id starts with "shield_" with one declaration, instead of repeating the animation on each overlay. Same target/targets selector syntax as base_svg.animations and per-overlay animations; matches shape, line, and control overlays uniformly.

routing.description: Global line routing configuration (lines can override with per-line properties)

default_mode.description: Card-wide override for every line whose own route is unset/auto (per-line route: still wins). auto (default): full pathfinding: obstacle avoidance, trunk bundling, crossing avoidance (this is what an unset line gets). manhattan/grid: force the whole card to the cheap/non-participating or no-refinement alternative instead. smart: same as auto, spelled out explicitly.

grid_resolution.description: Grid cell size for grid-based routing (viewBox units; values below 5 are coerced to 32). Unset by default; auto-scales from view_box size instead of a fixed number (~1/12th of the shorter dimension, clamped to [16, 64]; 64 shown here is that ceiling, not a fixed default)

min_stub_length_factor.description: Multiplier on the resolved grid_resolution for the minimum mandatory lead-out/lead-in stub every line reserves before routing runs. 1 (default) reproduces the router's own "at least one grid cell" floor; raise it to reserve more room for large corner_radius values, lower it (e.g. on a small view_box, where a flat floor would otherwise be disproportionately long) to let lines turn sooner

turn_penalty.description: A* cost for changing direction: higher values produce straighter paths with fewer turns

route_hint_penalty.description: A* cost for a first/last move that disagrees with route_hint/route_hint_last (soft, so obstacles still win)

smart_proximity.description: Proximity band for smart routing (viewBox units)

smart_detour_span.description: Maximum detour distance for smart routing (viewBox units)

smart_max_extra_bends.description: Maximum additional bends allowed by smart routing

smart_min_improvement.description: Minimum cost improvement to accept detour (viewBox units)

corner_room_weight.description: Card-wide default strength for recovering a line's full corner_radius near tight detours (see the per-line field of the same name for the full explanation). On by default; the LCARS rounded-corner look is the intended out-of-the-box result. Set to 0 to disable card-wide; individual lines can still opt back in via their own corner_room_weight.

channel_force_penalty.description: Penalty for lines outside forced channels

channel_prefer_bias.description: Per-cell A* discount for traveling along a prefer channel's own direction (scaled by channel weight)

channel_avoid_bias.description: Per-cell A* penalty for entering an avoid channel (scaled by channel weight and channel_avoid_multiplier)

trunk_bundling_enabled.description: Lines whose paths run close and parallel spontaneously bundle together and branch apart where needed

trunk_proximity.description: Maximum distance to a trunk lane to be considered "nearby" (viewBox units)

trunk_min_overlap.description: Minimum shared travel distance for joining a trunk to be worthwhile (viewBox units)

trunk_min_length.description: Minimum straight-run length to register as a new joinable trunk (viewBox units)

trunk_max_join_candidates.description: Maximum number of discovered trunks a single line will try to chain through

trunk_bundle_weight.description: Reward strength for joining a discovered trunk (same role as a channel's weight)

trunk_line_spacing.description: Default lane spacing for lines bundled on a discovered trunk (viewBox units)

trunk_discovery_max_passes.description: Cap on discovery passes before rendering, so every line's trunk/crossing data is known regardless of YAML order (safety limit against rare oscillation)

crossing_avoid_enabled.description: Penalize a line's path for cutting orthogonally across another already-routed line's segment

crossing_avoid_bias.description: Per-cell penalty for crossing another line's segment: a deterrent, not a hard block

crossing_min_length.description: Minimum straight-run length to register as avoidable (viewBox units), smaller than trunk_min_length so short stub legs are still avoidable

cost_defaults.description: Cost function weights for routing algorithms

bend.description: Cost weight for each bend/elbow in path

proximity.description: Cost weight for proximity to obstacles

channels.description: Named routing channels for bundling/separating lines with optional forced routing

mode.description: Channel behavior: prefer=encourage bundling, avoid=stay away, force=must route through

direction.description: Flow direction through channel (auto = infer from shape: wide=horizontal, tall=vertical)

weight.description: Channel influence strength (0-1, higher = stronger pull/push)

line_spacing.description: Gap between bundled lines in viewBox units (for prefer/force modes)

discoverable.description: Whether nearby lines that do NOT list this channel in their own route_channels may still spontaneously bundle into it. Default true matches automatic zero-config bundling; set false to scope this channel to only the lines that explicitly reference it via route_channels.

triggers_update.description: Card-wide escape hatch: every control overlay receives every HASS update unconditionally, bypassing the per-control entity-diff optimization for the whole card. Discouraged; prefer the per-overlay control `triggers_update: all` scoped to just the problem control.

data_sources.description: Data sources for real-time entity tracking, historical data, and processing pipelines. Each key defines a named data source accessible in templates.
data_sources.$comment: Data sources enable entity subscriptions, history preload, and unified processing pipeline

attribute.description: Entity attribute to track instead of state

enum_mapping.description: Map non-numeric states to numbers so they can be plotted or processed (on/off map to 1/0 automatically)

hours.description: Hours of history to preload (1-168, default: 6)

processing.description: Processing pipeline with named processors. Each processor transforms data and stores results in a buffer accessible via templates.

input_source.description: Name of another processor in this pipeline whose output this one reads (creates a dependency chain). If omitted, uses the raw entity value.

enabled.description: Set false to pass values through unchanged (default true)

from.description: convert_unit: source unit (e.g. c, f, w, kw). Not a chaining key: use input_source.

method.description: smooth: exponential | moving_average | gaussian. round: round | floor | ceil

alpha.description: smooth (exponential): weight of the newest value, 0 to 1 (default 0.3)

window.description: smooth: sample count (default 10). statistics: time window like "5m" or "session"

expression.description: expression: JavaScript expression using value/v, t, sources, entity and Math helpers

sources.description: expression: processor names available as sources[0], sources[1], ...

stats.description: statistics: min, max, mean, median, std_dev, q1, q3, range, count, sum

max_points.description: statistics: keep a time series of this many results

samples.description: trend: samples in the slope window (default 5)

threshold.description: trend: slope below which the trend is stable. threshold: switch point

hysteresis.description: threshold: dead band around the switch point

condition.description: duration: condition like "> 20" that starts the timer

reset_on.description: duration: condition that resets the timer

window_seconds.description: Rolling buffer window: seconds, or a duration like "5m" or "1h". About 10 points per second are kept, at most 1,000 (default 60)

min_emit_ms.description: Minimum ms between updates sent to cards (throttle, default 100)

coalesce_ms.description: Window in ms for merging rapid changes into one update (default: 40% of min_emit_ms, at least 20)

max_delay_ms.description: Longest ms an update may be held back while merging (default: 3 x coalesce_ms)

emit_on_same_value.description: Send updates even when the value did not change (default true)

lcards_msd_card_msd_overlays_item_style_.description: Single colour value applied to all entity states
lcards_msd_card_msd_overlays_item_style_.title: Simple Colour
State-Dependent Colours
lcards_msd_card_msd_overlays_item_style_.description: Map of entity state names to colour values. Well-known keys: default, active, inactive, unavailable, zero, non_zero, hover, pressed. Any custom state name (e.g. "heating", "above:90") is also accepted.
Fallback colour when no other state key matches
Colour when entity state is a non-zero number
Colour for a custom state key (e.g. "heating", "cooling", "above:90", "below:20")
Colour when entity state is numeric 0
